turns.replyText:
How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Hi, normally you’ll receive tracking by email once your order is scanned by the carrier.

For most orders, the shipping timeline depends on the estimated delivery date selected at checkout. We do not offer same-day shipping, and orders ship on the scheduled ship date that lines up with that estimated arrival window. Carrier delays can happen, and tracking usually appears once the package has been accepted and scanned.

A few things that can affect timing:

If checkout was done with Shop Pay, PayPal, or another express payment method, an estimated arrival date is assigned automatically.
If the order includes a pre-order item, everything ships together once all items are available.
Large orders can ship in more than one box, each with its own tracking number.

If you want, send me your order number or the email used at checkout and I’ll check your specific order.

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
yes, if you need to reroute an order to a different shipping address, our customer care team can help with that by phone.

Because shipping address changes can affect taxes based on the new location, any update is handled over the phone so any payment adjustment is taken care of correctly.

Our team can be reached at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.

If you’d like, I can also help with general shipping questions here.
